positions.name: Rifle squad
positions.manual: A few riflemen with suppressed carbines. Cheap and quiet, so they don't draw the horde. Good against Walkers and Runners in small numbers.

positions.name: Machine gun nest
positions.manual: A machine gun behind sandbags. Fires fast and slows the infantry-type zombies it hits. Loud: later, its noise will draw more of the horde.

positions.name: Sniper team
positions.manual: A sniper and a spotter. Long reach and heavy single shots, slow between them. Best for picking off dangerous zombies before they reach the line.
